clue.text: Convincing bonus involving a collection of 7 with no beginning

indicators.note: the word for bonus wraps around the single letter a, so it is involving it

parts.note: a plus is an extra or bonus

indicators.note: the word loses its opening letter, so it has no beginning

parts.note: 7 is the down answer meaning reserves, a word for volumes; the Bible is a collection of books

explanation.surface: Someone finds a reward persuasive because it comes with a set of something, oddly beheaded.
explanation.walkthrough: The cross-reference points to the down answer meaning reserves, i.e. volumes, so the collection is the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe a story or argument that seems believable and reasonable on its face.

clue.text: Telephonist's beginning to ring round for part of flower

indicators.note: the bell word goes round the letter, enclosing it

parts.note: a peal is a ringing of bells

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the word telephonist is taken

explanation.surface: A switchboard operator starts to ring around, asking about a flower part.
explanation.definitionFit: A coloured leaf-like segment of a bloom's corolla is what this word names.

clue.text: Bark in distress about love offered to Universal Artists

indicators.note: the word for distress sits about, i.e. around, the letter for love

parts.note: angst is anxiety or distress
love is nil in tennis, the letter O
U is the film-classification abbreviation for universal
RA, Royal Academician, stands for artists

explanation.surface: A dog barks in distress at affection shown to a film studio's artists.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bark' is not a dog's noise but tree bark: the bitter aromatic bark used to flavour cocktails.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the bitter bark of a South American tree, used in the famous aromatic bitters.

clue.text: Preachy type with two little homes round about Day One

indicators.note: the pair of home words go round the day and the one, enclosing them
two says the abbreviation for homes appears twice
about turns each abbreviation round so it is read backwards

parts.note: res, short for residence, is a little word for a home
Mon is the short form of Monday
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A moralising person owns two small homes and fusses about the first day of the week.
explanation.walkthrough: 'res' is an informal short form of residence; 'about' acts on each of the pair, not on the day.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who delivers moralising lectures is a preachy type, an often pejorative term.

clue.text: Composer's waste disposal unit containing old fishing equipment

definitions.note: the possessive is read as 'composer is', so the definition is just the composer

indicators.note: the rubbish word holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a bin is where waste is disposed of
a rod is an angler's equipment

explanation.surface: A composer's rubbish bin turns out to hold some ancient fishing tackle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Composer's' reads as 'composer is'. Alexander Borodin wrote Prince Igor.
explanation.definitionFit: This Russian composer of Prince Igor and the Polovtsian Dances was also a chemist.

clue.text: Those who have left after fourth part of Peter Grimes, upset

indicators.note: only the fourth letter of the name Peter is used
upset means the letters of the name are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: People walking out after Act Four of Britten's opera Peter Grimes, upset by it.
explanation.walkthrough: Peter Grimes is Britten's opera, which suggests the fourth act; 'upset' rearranges GRIMES to MIGRES.
explanation.definitionFit: People who have left their homeland, often for political reasons, are emigrants or exiles.

clue.text: Something tossed to erstwhile president interrupting erstwhile monarch

indicators.note: the president's name breaks into the monarch's letters

parts.note: CR, Carolus Rex, is King Charles
Abe is Abraham Lincoln, a former US president

explanation.surface: A former president cuts in on a former king to hand him something to throw.
explanation.walkthrough: In Highland games, competitors toss a long pine trunk end over end.
explanation.definitionFit: A tree trunk thrown in the Scottish Highland games is the thing tossed.

clue.text: Shell is something for detective to crack

definitions.meaning: a shell is an outer casing or container
a detective solves, or cracks, an investigation

explanation.surface: A shell is something a detective must break open.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both an outer covering and an investigation that a detective works on.

clue.text: Weep about securing adequate reserves

indicators.note: the reversed weeping word holds the other piece secure inside it
about turns the word for weep round to read backwards

parts.note: to sob is to weep
OK means adequate, all right

explanation.surface: Someone cries over keeping enough in reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to reserve a table or seat is to book it.

clue.text: Involuntary behaviour leading sometime chancellor to painter

indicators.note: the first piece comes ahead of, i.e. leading, the second

parts.note: REM, rapid eye movement, is involuntary activity during sleep
Willy Brandt was West German chancellor

explanation.surface: An unconscious habit sends a former chancellor off to see an artist.
explanation.walkthrough: Willy Brandt was West Germany's chancellor from 1969 to 1974; REM is rapid eye movement in sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dutch Golden Age master of the Night Watch is one of history's great painters.

clue.text: Row about origin of ginger cat

indicators.note: the row word goes about, round, the letter

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats

indicators.note: the origin is the first letter of the word ginger

explanation.surface: A dispute over where a ginger cat came from.
explanation.definitionFit: The striped big cat of Asia is the largest of the felines.

clue.text: Mental aberration — losing head — in spell of bad weather

indicators.note: losing head means the first letter goes

parts.note: a sudden fit of mental confusion or frenzy has this name, built on brain plus storm

explanation.surface: A moment of madness, a person losing their head, in a stretch of foul weather.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy downpour accompanied by wind is a spell of bad weather.

clue.text: Time's coming up for instructions to cobbler

definitions.meaning: a pub's final call before closing time is announced
a cobbler shapes shoes on a last

explanation.surface: A shoemaker is told that time is nearly up.
explanation.walkthrough: A cobbler's last is the foot-shaped block on which shoes are made; British pubs call last orders before closing.
explanation.definitionFit: The final call for drinks before a British pub closes warns that time is nearly up.

clue.text: Addict — one accessing website?

definitions.meaning: a person who accesses a site or computer system

explanation.surface: An addict is someone who visits a website.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is slang for a drug taker and the standard term for someone operating software.

clue.text: Gay 10 mouse with halo slipping

indicators.note: the letters slip out of place and are rearranged

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral ten

explanation.surface: A cheerful mouse whose halo is sliding off, ten times over.
explanation.walkthrough: The 10 looks like a cross-reference to 10 across, but here it is simply the Roman numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: Same-sex attraction is described by both words; gay is the everyday synonym.

clue.text: Warning to amusing person

definitions.meaning: informally, a funny or entertaining individual is called a ...

explanation.surface: A warning given to a funny person.
explanation.definitionFit: It means an admonition, and in old-fashioned slang a comically striking person.

clue.text: Musical involving a search for burial places

indicators.note: the show title takes the other letters into it

parts.note: Cats is the Lloyd Webber musical
to comb an area is to search it thoroughly

explanation.surface: A stage show that involves hunting for graves.
explanation.definitionFit: Underground galleries with recesses for tombs, as under Rome, are burial places.

clue.text: Cut the middle out, having had haircut outside

indicators.note: the clipped word goes outside the remaining letters

parts.note: shorn means having had hair or fleece cut off

indicators.note: the central letter of the word the is removed

explanation.surface: Instructions to trim away the middle bit after a haircut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cut the middle out' tempts as one instruction; in fact 'Cut' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To trim or reduce something in length is to make it less long.

clue.text: Believer receiving punishment from practitioner

indicators.note: the believer word takes in the punishment word

parts.note: a theist is a believer in God
to take the rap is to take punishment

explanation.surface: A man of faith is punished by a medical practitioner.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who treats patients, especially in psychology, is a practitioner of a therapy.

clue.text: Time to level about gym featuring acrobat's apparatus

indicators.note: the levelling word goes about, around, the gym letters

parts.note: to raze a building is to level it
PE, physical education, is school gym

explanation.surface: Time to flatten the gym where an acrobat's equipment hangs.
explanation.definitionFit: A swinging bar hung from ropes is the circus acrobat's apparatus.

clue.text: Prevalent 23 improbably in charge

indicators.note: improbably signals the letters arranged in an unlikely new way

parts.note: 23 is the down entry clued as correct

explanation.surface: A common correction, oddly placed in charge.
explanation.definitionFit: Of a disease, being regularly found in a region means it is widespread there.

clue.text: Undertaking to stick out

explanation.surface: An enterprise that protrudes.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun it is a planned enterprise; as a verb it means to protrude.

clue.text: Turned cheek to dour traveller

indicators.note: the word for cheek is turned to read backwards

parts.note: lip is impudence, cheek
grim means dour, stern

explanation.surface: A stern traveller offered their other cheek.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turned cheek' echoes turning the other cheek, a pious touch that suits the traveller.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who journeys to a holy place is a religious traveller.

clue.text: Strike copper with substantial volume

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
ff, fortissimo, is the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: Hit a policeman with a heavy book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Volume' is loudness, not a book: ff marks very loud music.
explanation.definitionFit: A light blow with the hand, a slap, is to strike someone.

clue.text: Sweet but unsatisfactory compromise

definitions.meaning: a botched solution that dodges the issue

explanation.surface: A deal that is sweet but unsatisfactory.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a soft sugary confection and also an evasive makeshift that dodges a real decision.

clue.text: Corrupt love securing endless period

indicators.note: the worship word holds the shortened period inside it

parts.note: to adulate is to adore

indicators.note: the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a term is a period, as of school or office

explanation.surface: Lust corrupts by gripping someone for a seemingly endless time.
explanation.definitionFit: To debase something by adding impure ingredients is to corrupt it.

clue.text: Correct journalist in pieces? On the contrary

indicators.note: in would put the journalist inside the pieces
on the contrary reverses that, so the pieces go inside the journalist

parts.note: ed, editor, is the usual crossword journalist
chessmen are pieces

explanation.surface: A reporter in bits is set right, or the other way round.
explanation.definitionFit: To edit a text and remove its errors is to correct it.

clue.text: Fibre supplying 19 across with energy

parts.note: 19 across is clued as stick out, which also means jut
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A fibre that makes an undertaking energetic.
explanation.definitionFit: This coarse plant fibre is used for sacking and rope.

clue.text: Dreamtime in which folk actor hugs former Tory leader

indicators.note: the actor word hugs, encloses, the leader's initials

parts.note: a mummer acts in traditional folk plays
IDS is Iain Duncan Smith, ex-leader of the Conservatives

explanation.surface: A dream in which a morris-style player embraces a past Conservative leader.
explanation.walkthrough: Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream makes the season a time of dreams; mummers perform traditional English folk plays.
explanation.definitionFit: The play title links the season to dreaming, so the time of the Dream is the late-June solstice.

clue.text: Get together, backing train losing both ends

indicators.note: first and last letters are dropped
backing turns the train word so it reads backwards

parts.note: a retinue is a train of attendants

explanation.surface: Join up, supporting a train that has lost both ends.
explanation.walkthrough: RETINUE reversed is EUNITER; losing both ends removes E and R.
explanation.definitionFit: To join or combine into a single whole is to come together.

clue.text: Root 26 across in the Home Counties

indicators.note: the marriage word goes in the region letters

parts.note: the Home Counties around London lie in South East England, SE
26 across is clued as get together, which as marrying is to wed

explanation.surface: Something rooted in the commuter belt around London.
explanation.walkthrough: The Home Counties are the counties surrounding London, in the South East (SE).
explanation.definitionFit: A yellow-fleshed root vegetable, called rutabaga in America, is a root.

clue.text: Took part, bearing left, and finished

indicators.note: the contest word carries the letter inside it

parts.note: competed means took part in a contest

explanation.surface: Someone joined in, veering left, and crossed the line.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done to the end is finished.
